name: donel-dev
description: Donel Dev — IDE própria do Alexandre para operar sessões do Claude Code em paralelo.
author: Seazone

scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/smoke/playwright.config.ts
scripts.tutorial: npm run build && playwright test -c .claude/skills/tutorial-e2e/lib/playwright.config.ts && node .claude/skills/tutorial-e2e/lib/relatorio.mjs
scripts.dist:alfa: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config.appId=com.seazone.doneldev.alfa "--config.productName=Donel Dev Alfa" "--config.nsis.shortcutName=Donel Dev Alfa"
scripts.dist:beta: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --config.appId=com.seazone.doneldev.beta "--config.productName=Donel Dev Beta" "--config.nsis.shortcutName=Donel Dev Beta"
